# T-1: Clarify Agent fallback

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Make Agent resolution select plugin command providers through the existing active/default/default-provider precedence and expose the resolution inputs for diagnostics.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R1, R3, and R6 pass for plugin and normal command ids.
- Unknown defaults do not silently select another provider.
- The implementation keeps source text generic and has no workflow-specific branch.

## Implementation Notes
Work in src/lib/agent.js and ProviderRegistry-facing resolution only as needed. Prefer a small resolution result/context class or helper over ad hoc object literals when it represents meaningful behavior.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local and shared unit tests instantiate Agent with synthetic configs for plugin command ids, active/default profiles, and bare built-in defaults such as codex.
